spine: The one-dimensional left–right axis loses information a five-axis model recovers.
Each axis earns its place by predicting a coalition the single line cannot.
Expert-survey (CHES) composites make the axes measurable but must be read with their caveats.
Worked profiles show the model classifying real actors — and where it strains.
